blurb: Guests can do their first tandem skydive from 10,000 feet for $219 on weekdays and $239 on weekends. The center is the closest dropzone to Dallas and Fort Worth, offering views of the Dallas skyline and Fort Worth. All tandem instructors and pilots are FAA and USPA certified.

quotes.author: Corin Tschoepe
quotes.text: I had an amazing experience with Dallas skydive center! We were able to call and book the day before our jump which took some of the anticipation out of the process ? I felt very well informed and safe from the start of our brief training to being 10,000 feet in the air and back on the ground! A tandem dive was especially great for me because you are really just along for a really amazing ride! If you are thinking about it, I say go for it!

quotes.author: Etienne Tenie
quotes.text: Most breath taking and life full experience I’ve even had. The view is unimaginable and unlike any other. For start to finish it was a very safe and well welcomed experience. The guides are well experienced and take care of each rider with the upmost precision landing and touch down is smooth and painless simply feel like jumping down two stair cases. 1000% would do again and at a higher height!!!!

quotes.author: Kaylin Christon
quotes.text: I came to do my first jump by myself and they exceeded my expectations!! From check in to leaving I had a great time. I was very nervous when I first got there, but they make sure to make you feel as comfortable as possible and answer any questions you have. I felt safe and comfortable which eased my nerves almost completely! The jump was amazing, and I plan on returning very soon!!

quotes.author: Maximo Aguinaga
quotes.text: Came to do my first jump for my 21st, decided to do it by myself. From the time I walked in, to the time we went into the air and back to the ground, I had no nerves due to all of the staff making you feel comfortable and confident. Patricia was my instructor and rocked! Highly recommend jumping here and having Patricia take you, in a perfectly good airplane!

quotes.author: Macie McEwen
quotes.text: LOVE THIS PLACE!!! My husband and I went and we had a blast. The staff here is wonderful in making sure we felt at ease and were comfortable. Lucas was my instructor and took a wonderful video and made me feel very safe. Thank you guys! I would highly recommend this place.

quotes.author: Kameron McDowell
quotes.text: Was my first tandem skydive ever and I absolutely loved it!!! 10/10 would do this again without question. My instructor Tom made my experience so much more memorable by walking me through the jump process and making me feel relaxed!
